warnings.message: Day 2 participants were selected using combined event performance, including Draft where applicable.
Final rank and overall event points are context only and are not used as Modern performance points.

final_rank_note.zh: 最终排名根据官方半决赛排名及决赛结果补齐；冠亚军按决赛结果确定，第 3 名起沿用半决赛排名。
final_rank_note.en: Final standings supplemented from official semifinal standings and the final result. First and second follow the final result; places 3 onward retain the semifinal standings.
